svg.aria-label: Which wire is positive, and which pad it goes to

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two independent facts settle this: the meter tells you which WIRE is positive, and the silkscreen on your own board tells you which PAD

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: is positive. Never infer either one from wire colour.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Battery plugged into the cable, switch ON.

ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The V with a straight line (V⎓), 20 V range or auto — not AC, not ohms.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Touch one probe to each bare end

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Red probe on one wire, black on the other. Keep the bare ends apart

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from each other — touching them together shorts the cell.

ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A tiny − is etched beside the upper oval and a tiny + beside

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the lower one, with BAT underneath. Read the PCB — it beats

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: every rule of thumb, including mine.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ⚠ This is the one irreversible mistake

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Reverse polarity kills the XIAO's charge chip. The two ovals sit

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ~2 mm apart, so a glue smear across both is just as fatal.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check twice; you only get to do this once.
